actor: FFIEC interagency Outsourcing and AIO booklets working-group drafting staff
job: Draft the booklet addendum extending bank third-party-risk supervision to agent-harness loaders and MCP-server channels with joint sign-off from OCC, FRB Board of Governors, FDIC, NCUA, and CFPB.
outcome: A jointly signed FFIEC booklet addendum published in Q3 2026 that names agent-harness loaders and MCP channels as a supervised third-party-risk class and cites the OWASP LLM Top 10 v2 and Trail of Bits agent-harness CVE taxonomies.
motivation: Once a supervised entity has an in-the-wild agent-harness exploitation event on CISA KEV and the underlying CVE class has crossed into double-digit cataloged instances, the existing outsourced-technology-service framing is no longer defensible and a focused addendum becomes the cheapest compliance pathway for both examiners and supervised entities.

task.where: the FFIEC interagency booklet working group channel and the federal-register comment-window workflow
task.when: drafting through May and June 2026 with a 60-90 day federal-register comment window opening in late June 2026
task.why: the addendum is the cheapest compliance pathway after a documented Fortune 500 exploitation event at a supervised entity
task.how: interagency booklet-addendum drafting with the OWASP LLM Top 10 v2 and Trail of Bits agent-harness CVE taxonomies as the canonical reference taxonomies

actor: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog operations team
job: Place CVE-2026-46127 on the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog inside the Mandiant incident-response engagement window at the Fortune 500 financial-services customer so the in-the-wild loss exposure is documented at a supervised entity.
outcome: CVE-2026-46127 listed on the CISA KEV catalog with the Mandiant Fortune 500 financial-services active-exploitation finding cited, establishing the documented activating trigger the FFIEC addendum can name as its precipitating risk event.
motivation: A KEV listing tied to a Fortune 500 supervised-entity engagement converts a hypothetical agent-harness risk surface into a documented exposure that the prudential-supervisor cohort can no longer read as covered by the generic outsourced-technology-service framing.
